description: This file defines the interface ParquetVectorUpdater for reading and decoding values from Parquet files in Spark's data source implementation.

classes.name: ParquetVectorUpdater
classes.description: An interface for updating and decoding Parquet vector data in Spark.

methods.name: readValues
methods.description: Reads a batch of values from a VectorizedValuesReader into a WritableColumnVector.

methods.name: skipValues
methods.description: Skips a batch of values in a VectorizedValuesReader.

methods.name: readValue
methods.description: Reads a single value from a VectorizedValuesReader into a WritableColumnVector.

methods.name: decodeDictionaryIds
methods.description: Decodes a batch of dictionary IDs into values using a Parquet dictionary.

methods.name: decodeSingleDictionaryId
methods.description: Decodes a single dictionary ID into a value in the vector.
